summary: Iteration 2: Editable Hours + Manage-My-Booking features tested end-to-end. Backend 100% green (32/32 tests passing including 15 new tests for hours GET/PATCH + availability propagation + manage token flow: get/reschedule/cancel/conflict/closed-day/completed-lock/invalid-token). Frontend Manage page (/manage/:token) fully works: renders booking, opens reschedule panel, lists dates/slots, cancels; invalid token shows manage-notfound. Admin Dashboard had a CRITICAL runtime crash (Gear icon not imported in AdminDashboard.jsx) that blanked the entire /admin page — I fixed the missing import; after fix the Hours dialog opens, all 7 day rows + toggles + inputs render, Save persists (verified availability first slot shifted to 10:00 after setting Monday open=10), and reset to defaults restored 08:00 slot. Stripe checkout now returns a valid https://checkout.stripe.com URL (regression from iter1 confirmed fixed). Dark theme (black/copper/gold) renders correctly on Home, /book, /admin/login, /manage — no contrast issues, phone (470) 390-9940 present.

minor.issue: No validation that open<close or that slot>0 — silently accepts nonsensical configs (returns empty slots via generate_day_slots guard). Consider 400 for invalid ranges so admin sees the error.

Success response emits notify_status_change with status='confirmed' spoofed, but persistent status is reset to 'pending' — customer will get an email that reads 'confirmed' while the DB says pending. Cosmetic email/state mismatch.
Response includes manage_token, slot_key, origin_url — sensitive-ish internal fields. Consider projecting only user-facing fields.

ui_bugs.issue: CRITICAL (fixed by testing agent): `<Gear>` icon was rendered on line 117 but was NOT in the @phosphor-icons/react import list. This caused a React runtime error 'Gear is not defined' that unmounted the entire AdminDashboard, leaving /admin a blank black screen and making the Editable Hours feature completely unreachable. Added `Gear` to the imports; feature now works.

issues: Radix DialogContent is missing an aria-describedby / Description — accessibility warning in console (not blocking).
Date strip includes 'today' even if past business open; acceptable but adding a min offset (>=1 day) could avoid same-day reschedules the shop can't honor.

action_items: Please review my one-line fix to /app/frontend/src/pages/AdminDashboard.jsx (added `Gear` to the phosphor-icons import). Without it, the admin dashboard crashes entirely.
(Optional) Return 400 from PATCH /api/admin/settings/hours when open>=close or slot<=0 instead of silently saving.
(Optional) Fix notify_status_change payload in manage_reschedule — currently the customer email says 'confirmed' while the DB is set to 'pending' (line 646 of server.py).
(Optional) Strip internal fields (manage_token, slot_key, origin_url) from the public GET /api/bookings/manage/{token} response.
critical_code_review_comments: AdminDashboard.jsx: Missing Gear import — caught by runtime; fixed. Consider adding an ErrorBoundary around AdminDashboard so a single icon typo doesn't blank the whole admin app.
server.py manage_reschedule (line 645-646): status is set to 'pending' but the email uses {**b, 'status':'confirmed'} — misleading. Either notify with the real status or don't spoof.
server.py generate_day_slots: silently returns [] on invalid config (close<=open or slot<=0). Fine as a safety net but PATCH endpoint should validate & 400.
ManageBooking.jsx: uses window.confirm for cancel — acceptable but a themed Dialog would match the dark UI better.
server.py get_hours: inserts default doc on first read but returns DEFAULT_HOURS (not the just-inserted doc) — fine but has a tiny race window with concurrent PATCH.
Backend startup index: db.bookings.create_index on slot_key unique+sparse is good — provides the atomic conflict guard I flagged in iter1.

success_rate.frontend: 100% after Gear import fix (Manage page, Admin Hours dialog, Home, Book, Admin login all verified)

context_for_next_testing_agent: backend_test.py (iter1) + test_iteration2.py cover services, availability, bookings CRUD/conflict, Stripe checkout+status, admin auth gating, admin status/reschedule, PUBLIC & ADMIN business hours GET/PATCH with availability propagation and closed-day handling, and customer manage_token flow (get / reschedule success / invalid slot / closed day / 409 conflict / cancel + slot freed / completed-lock 400). Run: pytest /app/backend/tests/ -v. Frontend test cookies: seed admin session per /app/auth_testing.md and set as session_token cookie. If Admin still shows blank, check that Gear is imported.
rca of the issue: AdminDashboard.jsx referenced <Gear /> (line 117) to render the Hours button icon but the phosphor-icons import list was never updated with `Gear`. React threw 'Gear is not defined' during render, the ErrorBoundary-less tree unmounted, and /admin displayed a blank black screen. Symptom mistakenly looked like a routing/auth failure. Fix: add `Gear` to the destructured import from '@phosphor-icons/react'. Verified: admin-dashboard element renders, admin-hours-btn is clickable, hours-dialog opens with hours-day-0..6 rows, save + availability propagation confirmed (first Monday slot became 10:00 after setting open=10).
